Who is Dirge of Cerberus -Final Fantasy VII- characters?

The following is a list of characters from Dirge of Cerberus -Final Fantasy VII-.

The multiplayer mode featured several Deepground characters that do not appear in the single player mode. These characters were typically involved in instructing the player character and assigning quests.
